profile.headline: Self-taught UI/UX designer, and front-end developer for web and mobile
profile.summary: Computer Science graduate and Tech fanatic. Currently working as a CRM software engineer at Ayulla Inc. using the following languages/tools: Python, Figma, HTML, CSS, Jira. Open to new UX/UI, Front-End development opportunities. Currently finishing the Google UX Design Certificate.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop functional and appealing web- and mobile-based applications based on usability using Python.
•	Design user interfaces for 3K+ clients on Figma focusing on user-centered design methods. 
•	Increased 10% of user accounts by translating technical information from English to Spanish across all browsers and platforms.

positions.title: Video Production Assistant
positions.description:
•	Reached new 50K+ student enrollments by producing, filming, and editing English academic online courses.
•	Supported scripts, storyboarding, graphics, and visions of over 10 online program initiatives.

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
•	Assessed 500+ international students by problem-solving their academic and administrative inquiries at the front desk, local events, field trips, office operations, and social media.
•	Improved the overall experience to 1/3 of the student population who speaks Spanish as their interpreter.

positions.title: Facebook’s Above & Beyond CS (ABCS) Workshop
positions.description: Applied practice to master common data structures and algorithms covered in interviews

honors.title: TWITTER 2017 #TECHPROUD SPRING CAMP
honors.description: 1 of 27 attendees selected out of 900+ applicants to attend a one-day interactive program for 2nd-year computer science majors focused on professional and technical development including networking, personal branding, resume writing, interview and coding skills

honors.title: IME-BECAS Scholarship Foundation
honors.description: 1 of 8 low-income Hispanic/Latino students to receive $2,000 academic scholarship for one school year

projects.title: Colorful Spots - LGBTQ+ Business Directory
projects.description: •Included 100+ friendly businesses for LGBTQ+ individuals in the Atlanta region by designing a business directory using Yelp’s database, MYSQL, React, GraphQL, Mapbox, and HMTL/CSS.

projects.title: Park Me! - Automated Parking System
projects.description: •Reduced parking time by 28% (8 min) by developing a web application using React, Google’s Firebase, and Mapbox API to find parking spots and reserve in advance.
